title: Synergy Baseball App: Reports View
description: Generate, read, save and reuse the 11 report types in Reports view, and manage report tabs.

modules.title: Getting Started with Reports View
modules.summary: Pick a team or a player type and player, then switch report types from the drop-down.
learning_objectives: Open Reports view and build a team or player report
Read the color scale and player filters
modules.content:
## Opening and building a report

Reports View shows statistical reports for the most frequently viewed data. Open it with the **Reports View** icon at the top right.

![The Reports View icon](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565389-01.jpg)

- **Team reports**: select a league, season and team.
- **Individual player reports**: choose a player type (pitcher, hitter, fielder, baserunner or catcher) then the player. You can search by name after filtering by type.
- **Change report type**: the default is **Basic Statistics**; use the report drop-down at the top right.

## The 11 report types

Basic Statistics (default), Left/Right Splits, Matchups (Count), Pitch Types (Pitch Result), Pitch Type (BIP Result), Synergy Pitcher Attributes, Synergy Hitter Attributes, Pickoffs, Stolen Bases, Fielding, Throwing.

## Reading the cells

Cells are color-coded on an efficiency scale from **low (grey) to high (blue)**.

## What each player filter shows

- **Pitcher**: every pitch thrown for that team in the time frame.
- **Hitter**: every pitch seen.
- **Fielder**: every fielding play involved in.
- **Baserunner**: every pitch while on base.
- **Catcher**: every pitch received.

questions.question: What is the default report in Reports View?
questions.explanation: Basic Statistics is the default report.

questions.question: In Reports view, what does a blue cell indicate?
options: A high value on the efficiency scale
questions.explanation: Cells run from grey (low) to blue (high).

questions.question: The Catcher(s) player filter shows what data?
questions.explanation: It shows every pitch the catcher received for that team in the time frame.

modules.title: Report Types in Depth
modules.summary: Each report breaks the data down differently; percentages are always relative to a stated column or row.
learning_objectives: Match a question to the right report
Know which values do not play video
modules.content:
## Pick the report for the question

- **Basic Statistics**: six tables (Basic Statistics, Pitch Type, Pitch Result, BIP Type, BIP Result, Non-BIP Result), same as Multigame.

![Basic Statistics report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-01.jpg)
- **Left/Right Splits**: pitches by hitter/pitcher handedness at different counts. Tabs: **Grouped Counts** and **All Counts**. Expand with the carat to see pitch types, then pitch results.

![Left/Right Splits report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-02.jpg)
- **Matchups (Counts)**: the filtered player against all hitters/pitchers, then individuals. Percentage = column total / the **All** column.

![Matchups report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-03.jpg)
- **Pitch Types (Pitch Result)** and **Pitch Types (BIP Result)**: results by pitch type. Expand for **In-Zone / Out-Of-Zone** and **AVG / SLG / BABIP** sub-rows.

![Pitch Types (Pitch Result) report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-04.jpg)

![Pitch Types (BIP Result) report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-05.jpg)
- **Synergy Pitcher Attributes**: pitch result and BIP trajectory tabs; percentage = column / **All Pitches**.

![Synergy Pitcher Attributes report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-06.jpg)
- **Synergy Hitter Attributes**: balls in play only; percentage = column / **All BIP**.

![Synergy Hitter Attributes report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-07.jpg)
- **Pickoffs**: when and where pickoffs occur; percentage = column / **Total**.

![Pickoffs report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-08.jpg)
- **Stolen Bases**: attempts by a baserunner, or against pitchers and catchers; percentage = column / **SB Attempts**.

![Stolen Bases report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-09.jpg)
- **Fielding**: touches by BIP type, fielding type, direction and extra effort; percentage = column / **Total Touches**.

![Fielding report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-10.jpg)
- **Throwing**: throw type, target base, accuracy; percentage = column / **All Throws**.

![Throwing report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565390-11.jpg)

## Video gotcha

AVG, SLG, BABIP (and OBP/OPS in Basic Statistics) rows do **not** play video. Click the number above the percentage, the In-Zone/Out-of-Zone row, or the total counts row instead.

![Video playback options in the upper left of every view](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565393-01.jpg)

questions.question: In the Stolen Bases report, percentages are calculated against which column?
questions.explanation: Stolen Bases percentages use the SB Attempts column.

questions.question: Which report would you use to see In-Zone vs Out-Of-Zone results by pitch type?
questions.explanation: Pitch Types reports expand to In-Zone and Out-Of-Zone sub-rows.

questions.question: The Synergy Hitter Attributes report includes which data?
questions.explanation: It includes balls in play only, with percentages vs All BIP.

questions.question: How do you play video behind an AVG row?
options: You cannot; click the number above it or a total row instead
questions.explanation: AVG/SLG/BABIP rows do not play video; use counts or totals.

modules.title: Report Tabs and Saved Reports
modules.summary: Use the blue report tab to save, duplicate and manage reports, then reload them from Saved Reports.
learning_objectives: Create tabs for multiple players with Duplicate Tab - Multiple
Save, load and delete saved reports
modules.content:
## The report tab

After you generate a report in Multigame or Reports view, a blue **report tab** appears at the bottom of the window. Click its **caret** to see:

![The blue report tab at the bottom of the window](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565368-01.jpg)

- **Save** / **Save As** (name it first)
- **Duplicate Tab**: edit one version, switch between them
- **Duplicate Tab - Multiple**: one tab per selected player
- **Add New Tab**: work on several reports at once
- **Undo Last**: reverses the most recent filter
- **Revert To Saved**: discards filters applied since saving
- **Rename Tab** and **Close Tab** (prompts to save changes)

## Duplicate Tab - Multiple

1. Select players with the radio buttons (or the position title radio for everyone).
2. By default each tab includes all seasons the player has played; click the caret next to a name to pick seasons.

![Selecting players and seasons for Duplicate Tab - Multiple](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565368-02.jpg)
3. Click **Apply**. New tabs appear at the bottom.

![New report tabs listed at the bottom of the app window](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565368-03.jpg)

## Saved Reports

- **Save**: filter your data, click the caret on the active tab, choose **Save** or **Save As**.

![The caret on the active report tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565396-01.jpg)

![Save and Save As options](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565396-02.jpg)
- **Open**: go to **Saved Reports**, tick the radio button by the report, click **Load**.

![Loading a saved report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565396-03.jpg)
- **Delete**: tick the **Delete** radio button at the top right, then click the **X** by each report to remove.

![Deleting saved reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565396-04.jpg)

questions.question: Which feature creates one report tab per selected player?
questions.explanation: Duplicate Tab - Multiple creates a tab for each selected player.

questions.question: What does Revert To Saved do?
options: Returns a saved report to its original state, discarding later filters
questions.explanation: It discards any filters applied since the last save.

questions.question: How do you open a saved report?
options: Saved Reports > select its radio button > Load
questions.explanation: Select the report in Saved Reports and click Load.
